title: Purchase of tickets for Isla Fantasía
text: At first my father told me that it would have been better to buy them through the official Isla Fantasía website, but in the end I bought them here, and everything was really very good. Besides, I used a promo code and the site gave me a good discount. Very satisfied, honestly, with the site and with the park, there are quite a few slides and chutes, highly recommended.👌👌
author: anarelaluc_am2026

title: Great day out
text: Great fun place for the kids - very very busy in morning but quieter by afternoon. A little tired but clean enough
author: Jasmine_S

title: Highly recommended. Great family friendly experience!
text: The water park is just great! Had so much fun with the kids that we wished the park remained open for longer hours. We loved everything there (the rides, the swimming pools, the picnic area,...). The staff were very friendly and helpful.  Would definitely come back and would highly recommend it for a family friendly day out.
author: Hafid_a

title: Great for the kids
text: The kids loved it. It didn’t take us long to get there from The Gothic Quarter. Lots of lifeguards. Pools were clean. Lots of choices of slides. There’s also a shaded park area. €4 for sun beds and you have to pay for lockers. We had a great day
author: Nicola J

title: Nashat Raouf
text: Best day ever for my family .........,sure we will come back next year.....one of the best day in Barcelona....

author: Frances S

title: Such great value for money. Our two...
text: Such great value for money. Our two girls 6 and 4 had such fun and were able to goon the majority of the slides. It's a get way to spend a day if you're looking for something to keep the kids entertained.
author: Taureon_R

title: We took our 9 and 12 year old...
text: We took our 9 and 12 year old daughters to Illa Fantasi and we all had a really fun time! The pools and park were very clean and well maintained. Would recommend it!
author: Christina D

title: Excellent day at water park,free...
text: Excellent day at water park,free shuttle service to and from very good, great value family day out,would recommend using Julia travel for excursions whilst in Barcelona,also very good cafe outside pickup point and very reasonable.
